# Country scope. Byzantium itself or one of its themes (the land of a theme is still imperial land).
oe_trc_byz_side = {
    OR = {
        tag = BYZ
        AND = { exists = c:BYZ oe_theme_member_trigger = yes }
    }
}
# Location scope, inside on_action on_location_changed_owner: the new owner (scope:winner, else the owner) is
# Byzantium or one of its themes.
oe_trc_new_owner_byz = {
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:winner }
        scope:winner = { oe_trc_byz_side = yes }
    }
    trigger_else = { owner ?= { oe_trc_byz_side = yes } }
}
# Location scope. Carries one of this track's settlement modifiers (then it is not asked again).
oe_trc_settled = {
    OR = { has_location_modifier = oe_trc_settle_a has_location_modifier = oe_trc_settle_b has_location_modifier = oe_trc_settle_bp has_location_modifier = oe_trc_settle_c has_location_modifier = oe_trc_settle_d }
}
